read_COLMAP_model: read a COLMAP reconstruction model from a directory in binary or text format
write_COLMAP_model: write a COLMAP reconstruction model with cameras, images, and 3D points to a directory
convert_qvec_to_rotmat: convert a quaternion vector to a 3x3 rotation matrix
convert_rotmat_to_qvec: convert a 3x3 rotation matrix to a quaternion vector
read_COLMAP_images_binary: read COLMAP image registration data including poses and 2D point correspondences from a binary file
